verses.la: Magníficat ✠ * ánima mea Dóminum.
verses.en: My soul ✠ * doth magnify the Lord.

verses.la: Et exsultávit spíritus meus: * in Deo, salutári meo.
verses.en: And my spirit hath rejoiced * in God my Saviour.

verses.la: Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
verses.en: Because he hath regarded the humility of his handmaid; * for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

verses.la: Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.
verses.en: Because he that is mighty, hath done great things to me; * and holy is his name.

verses.la: Et misericórdia eius, a progénie in progénies: * timéntibus eum.
verses.en: And his mercy is from generation unto generations, * to them that fear him.

verses.la: Fecit poténtiam in brácchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
verses.en: He hath shewed might in his arm: * he hath scattered the proud in the conceit of their heart.

verses.la: Depósuit poténtes de sede: * et exaltávit húmiles.
verses.en: He hath put down the mighty from their seat, * and hath exalted the humble.

verses.la: Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.
verses.en: He hath filled the hungry with good things; * and the rich he hath sent empty away.

verses.la: Suscépit Israël púerum suum: * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.
verses.en: He hath received Israel his servant, * being mindful of his mercy:

verses.la: Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros: * Ábraham, et sémini eius in sǽcula.
verses.en: As he spoke to our fathers, * to Abraham and to his seed for ever.

v.la: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
v.en: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

r.la: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
r.en: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

verses.la: Benedíctus ✠ Dóminus, Deus Israël: * quia visitávit, et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:
verses.en: Blessed be the Lord ✠ God of Israel; * because he hath visited and wrought the redemption of his people:

verses.la: Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.
verses.en: And hath raised up an horn of salvation to us, * in the house of David his servant:

verses.la: Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum eius:
verses.en: As he spoke by the mouth of his holy Prophets, * who are from the beginning:

verses.la: Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.
verses.en: Salvation from our enemies, * and from the hand of all that hate us:

verses.la: Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
verses.en: To perform mercy to our fathers, * and to remember his holy testament,

verses.la: Iusiurándum, quod iurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:
verses.en: The oath, which he swore to Abraham our father, * that he would grant to us,

verses.la: Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.
verses.en: That being delivered from the hand of our enemies, * we may serve him without fear,

verses.la: In sanctitáte, et iustítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.
verses.en: In holiness and justice before him, * all our days.

verses.la: Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias eius:
verses.en: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: * for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways:

verses.la: Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi eius: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:
verses.en: To give knowledge of salvation to his people, * unto the remission of their sins:

verses.la: Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:
verses.en: Through the bowels of the mercy of our God, * in which the Orient from on high hath visited us:

verses.la: Illumináre his, qui in ténebris, et in umbra mortis sedent: * ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
verses.en: To enlighten them that sit in darkness, and in the shadow of death: * to direct our feet into the way of peace.

v.la: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
v.en: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

r.la: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
r.en: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

conclusions.note: The conclusion is not invariant: in Paschaltide Lauds and Vespers take "Benedicámus Dómino, allelúia, allelúia" and Matins does not. Every day in the coverage window was rendered rather than deriving a rubric rule.

la: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
en: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.
℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.
℣. Eternal rest * grant unto them, O Lord.
℟. And let perpetual light * shine upon them.
